title: Optimization Review & KPI Re-Baseline Questionnaire
lede: The recurring instrument fielded after the customer is live — first at 3–6 months, then on the tier's cadence. Its job is neither scope nor readiness: it is *movement*. Every answer either re-measures a baseline number, records a change that was made on the account, or reads the renewal signal. A review that produces no delta against the last one is a review that was not worth fielding.

meta.Instrument: Guided review (SA + CSM, with the customer's ops owner)
meta.Fielded: 3–6 months post-go-live, then quarterly / monthly by tier
meta.Output: KPI delta register · remediation log · renewal signal

questions.text: Customer / account name
Review period covered (from / to)
Which review is this?
questions.logic: Sets which sections are required. A pre-renewal review makes O7 required regardless of tier.

questions.text: Who contributed to this review?
questions.logic: A review missing the SA has no remediation evidence; a review missing the CSM has no renewal signal. Both roles are the point of the instrument.

questions.text: Time since go-live:
Rollout is complete across all sites, departments and channels that were in scope.
questions.logic: A score below 4 means part of the estate is not yet generating the data the rest of this review depends on. Note which part in O1.4.

questions.text: Licensed seats: ____  ·  Active in the last 30 days: ____  ·  Dormant (0 use in 30 days): ____
questions.logic: The dormant count is the license-reclamation lever. It maps directly to the L1 utilization output and the renewal right-sizing conversation.

questions.text: Which capabilities are now in production?
questions.logic: "Live, low adoption" is an adoption-campaign target for the CSM, not a technical gap. "Configured, not launched" is the opposite. The instrument has to separate them because the owner and the fix differ.

questions.text: What is not yet live that was expected to be by now, and why?
Service level — Baseline: ____  ·  Current: ____  ·  Threshold used (e.g. 80/20): ____
questions.logic: Re-measures post-SOW B2. If the threshold differs from the baseline's, this is a definition change, not a movement — flag it in O2.7.

questions.text: Average speed of answer (ASA) — Baseline: ____  ·  Current: ____
Abandonment rate — Baseline: ____  ·  Current: ____  ·  Short-abandon exclusion (seconds): ____
Average handle time (AHT) — Baseline: ____  ·  Current: ____
First contact resolution (FCR) — Baseline: ____  ·  Current: ____  ·  How measured: ____
Self-service containment (virtual agent) — Baseline: ____  ·  Current: ____
Where did the current figures come from?
questions.logic: Anything below "Zoom-native" carries the same provenance caveat as the post-SOW baseline. A current figure measured less rigorously than the baseline cannot be claimed as an improvement.

questions.text: For any metric that moved materially, what change caused it? (Links to O3.)
Since the last review — Findings raised: ____  ·  Actioned: ____  ·  Deferred: ____  ·  Won't-do: ____
questions.logic: The actioned-over-raised ratio is the single clearest signal of whether the optimization loop is actually running or just producing reports.
blanks: Since the last review — Findings raised

questions.text: Status of the highest-priority findings by layer.
questions.logic: "Blocked (customer)" is a renewal-risk flag as much as a delivery one — it means value is being withheld by something outside our control, and it belongs in O6.

questions.text: What was the single highest-impact change made this period, and what did it move?
Overall 11-layer score vs. last review:
Dormant licenses reclaimed / reassigned this period: ____  ·  Estimated annual $ recovered: ____
questions.logic: The most defensible line in the renewal business case, because it is arithmetic the customer can verify against their own admin console.
blanks: Dormant licenses reclaimed / reassigned this period

questions.text: Agent capacity reclaimed (from AHT / occupancy gains): ____ FTE-equivalent
blanks: Agent capacity reclaimed (from AHT / occupancy gains)

questions.text: Interactions deflected to self-service this period: ____  ·  Estimated $ avoided: ____
blanks: Interactions deflected to self-service this period

questions.text: In one paragraph, the value story for this period in the customer's terms.
questions.logic: This is what goes on the renewal slide. If it cannot be written from the numbers above, the review did not produce a renewal case and O7 should say so honestly.

questions.text: Has the customer acknowledged this value?
questions.logic: "They dispute it" is the most valuable answer here — a disputed value figure caught at a quarterly review is recoverable; the same dispute at the renewal table is not.

questions.text: CSAT — Baseline: ____  ·  Current: ____  ·  Method: ____
Agent experience / eNPS, if measured — Baseline: ____  ·  Current: ____
blanks: Agent experience / eNPS, if measured — Baseline

questions.text: The customer's ops team is confident operating the platform without us.
questions.logic: A rising score is the healthy outcome, but a very high score early can signal a Transform-tier account that no longer sees a reason to pay for hands-on optimization. Read it with O7.

questions.text: Any notable quotes, complaints or wins from agents, supervisors or end customers.
Which risks are live right now?
options: A key sponsor left or disengaged

questions.text: For each live risk, the owner, the action and the date.
Overall account health this period:
questions.logic: This is the CSM's call, informed by the SA's remediation evidence. A green account with a low O3.1 actioned ratio and a disputed O4.5 is not green — the sub-signals override the headline.

questions.text: Renewal date and notice window
Renewal trajectory as it stands today:
Which tier fits this account for the next term?
questions.logic: The tier recommendation must be defensible from this review's data. An account you want to move to Transform needs an O4 value story and an O1.3 with real expansion headroom, or the upsell will not survive procurement.

questions.text: Expansion / whitespace identified:
The single next action that most improves the renewal outcome, its owner, and its date.
